Package index

A study’s imputed mean and SD with their standard errors

The study-level function for practitioners.

se_imputed() print(<se_imputed>)
Imputed mean and SD of one study, with their plug-in standard errors
se_imputed_df()
Imputed means and SDs with their standard errors for every study of a data frame
se_imputed_diff()
The effect of two groups per study, with its naive and exact standard errors

Pooling

The pooled estimate under the naive and the exact standard errors, side by side.

pool_imputed() print(<pool_imputed>)
Pool the studies under the naive and the exact standard errors, side by side

The exact factors

The standard deviation factors and the inflation factors of the imputed mean and SD, under normality.

c_mu()
The scalar C_mu(n): standard deviation of the imputed mean in units of sigma
c_sigma()
The scalar C_sigma(n): standard deviation of the imputed SD in units of sigma
inflation_factors()
Inflation factors of the imputed mean and SD
imputed_moments()
Second moments of the imputed mean and SD from a five-number summary

The shortcut formulas

Closed forms in the sample size, with the constants as the companion paper prints them.

c_mu_shortcut()
Shortcut formula for C_mu(n)
c_sigma_shortcut()
Shortcut formula for C_sigma(n)

Weights and ranks

estimator_weights()
Weight vectors of the published quantile-based estimators and the BLUE
scenario_ranks()
Ranks of the order statistics reported under each scenario

Data

The six studies of the vitamin D meta-analysis, the mean case of the second vignette.

vitd
Serum vitamin D in tuberculosis cases and controls: six studies
